# 计数是关系：计数存在恰当所计数者已定，判定程序的标记就是计数；计数之间的普查不用可判定性 / Counting is a relation: a count exists exactly where what it counts is decided, and a decision procedure's marks are the count; the census between counts needs no decidedness

## 主张 Claim

一个命题已定（Decided），是指它成立或不成立；判定程序（Decidable）把这一点作为数据给出，核心的逻辑不对每个命题假定它，已定不能被否证（not_not_decided）。一个数指示一个命题（Indicates），是指它为一而命题成立，或为零而命题不成立；一个数计列表中某规定成立的成员（Counts），是指它是这些指示之和；跨一列步，各步的计数相加（CountsAcross）。某数指示一个命题恰当该命题已定（indicates_iff_decided），列表的计数存在恰当每个成员已定（counts_iff_decided）；计数唯一（Counts.unique），不超过成员数（Counts.le_length）；判定程序给出的标记之和就是计数（counts_total、comings_counts、ceasings_counts）。计数之间的普查不用可判定性：一段步上，只要计数存在，终点成立的加其间不再成立的，等于起点成立的加其间开始成立的（Counts.over_stretch），段内各步也不要求已定：段内各步已定时它成立（Counts.over_stretch_decided），有限多个状态都已定不能被否证，而数的等式在其否定被否证处成立。跨一步亦然（Counts.across_step）；开始与不再成立的计数相差不超过成员数（CountsAcross.keep_pace）。成立者在各步被列出、每个一次时，列表本身给出普查，也不用可判定性（Counts.listed_across、Counts.listed_over_stretch）：计数是被计成员列表的长度（Counts.listing），成员相同、不重复的两个列表一样长（length_eq_of_same）。不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。 / A proposition is decided (Decided) where it holds or fails; a decision procedure (Decidable) gives this as data, the core's logic does not assume it of every proposition, and that a proposition is decided cannot be refuted (not_not_decided). A number indicates a proposition (Indicates) where it is one and the proposition holds, or zero and it fails; a number counts the members of a list of which a determination holds (Counts) where it sums their indicators; across a list of steps, the counts at each step sum (CountsAcross). Something indicates a proposition exactly where the proposition is decided (indicates_iff_decided), and a count of a list exists exactly where each member is decided (counts_iff_decided); a count is one number (Counts.unique), at most the members (Counts.le_length), and where a procedure decides, its marks are the count (counts_total, comings_counts, ceasings_counts). The census between counts needs no decidedness: over a stretch, wherever the counts exist, those holding at the end with those that ceased are those holding at the start with those that came to be (Counts.over_stretch), with no decidedness even at the steps inside the stretch: decided there, the census holds (Counts.over_stretch_decided), that finitely many states are all decided cannot be refuted, and an equation of numbers holds wherever its failure is refuted. Likewise across one step (Counts.across_step), and comings and ceasings differ by at most the members (CountsAcross.keep_pace). Where what holds is listed at each step, each member once, the lists give the census with no decidedness either (Counts.listed_across, Counts.listed_over_stretch): a count is the length of a list of the members counted (Counts.listing), and two lists without repetition with the same members are equally long (length_eq_of_same). No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used.

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 计数的规律：计数存在（Counts）；段内各步不要求已定。 / The laws of counting: the counts exist (Counts); the steps inside the stretch need not be decided.
- 列出的形式：成立者在各步被列出、每个一次（Listed）。 / The listed forms: what holds is listed at each step, each member once (Listed).
- 离散的步；有限的列表。 / Discrete steps; finite lists.

Ren 2026-10-11：“give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”，并以“please”接受 AI 的建议：可判定性局部化，不再是表示的承诺（零前提计划 §1.4 (b2)）。AI 的读法：“too dualist”读作强加给生成的是或否之分；“局部”读作只在所计数之处、作为该规律自己的条件。计数之间的规律对任何存在的计数成立，不要求它们存在；需要计数的陈述把已定写作条件，范围是所计数之处。读法待 Ren。 / Ren, 11 October 2026: “give me more context, but i intuitively feel decidability is too dualist, also proved solutions and their pro/cons”, and “please” to the AI's suggestion that decidability be made local, no longer a commitment of the representation (zero-premise plan, section 1.4 (b2)). The AI's reading: “too dualist” is the yes/no split imposed on becoming; “local” is at the states counted only, as that law's own condition. The laws between counts hold of whatever counts exist, without asking that they exist; a statement that needs a count states decidedness as its condition, at what it counts. The reading awaits Ren.

计数存在要求所计数者已定，这是定理（counts_iff_decided），不是对世界的前提；陈述以 mark 计数的定理仍以判定程序为自己的条件，清点页逐条列出；只对离散步与有限列表陈述；读法是 AI 的，待 Ren。 / A count existing needs what it counts to be decided, a theorem (counts_iff_decided), not a premise on worlds; theorems whose statements count by mark keep a decision procedure as their own condition, listed on the inventory page; stated for discrete steps and finite lists; the readings are the AI's, pending Ren.

- undecided 世界（World.undecided）有限，生起复现（World.undecided_world）；要求每个有限世界中生起复现给出止息复现的规律，在 undecided Q 上判定任一命题 Q（World.law_decides），所以对每个有限世界要求复现的规律而不给已定，就是排中律（World.law_iff_em）：计数之间的规律不用可判定性，复现的确切形式要用。 / The undecided world (World.undecided) is finite, with arising recurring (World.undecided_world); a law giving ceasing recurring from arising recurring in every finite world decides any proposition Q at undecided Q (World.law_decides), so asking the recurrence law of every finite world without decidedness is excluded middle (World.law_iff_em): the laws between counts need no decidedness, the exact form of recurrence does.
